name: 32589-prefillheavy-nemotronnano9b-1gpu
model: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2, bf16, ungated and public. NOT substitutable: this is a hybrid recurrent/attention architecture and a dense model is served by a different path. ~16.6 GiB of weights.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, SM90. One node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: tp1 -- TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP off.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 64 streams, warmup the first 20%, cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 2000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, over /v1/completions. 512 prompt tokens and 1 output token as POINT values (min == max), random tokens sharing no prefix, `ignore_eos`, temperature 0, seed 32589.
purpose: A classification service scoring 512-token documents with a 9B hybrid model, 64 concurrent single-token requests on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser and the engine would
# then start without it. `extra_buffer` is refused on any linear-attn backend other than triton
# and raises at startup with --disable-radix-cache, so those two lines travel together.

model-path: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2
tp-size: 1
mamba-radix-cache-strategy: extra_buffer
linear-attn-backend: triton
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
context-length: 4096
max-running-requests: 64
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
random-seed: 32589
